tier_should.rationale: Unique RCT of guest worker offers; large sample; credible design; novel MTE to quantify pecuniary vs non-pecuniary costs; important migration and welfare implications; limited external validity to male UAE construction and relies on linear MTE.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors and policy relevance support top placement. Yet external validity, subjective well-being measures, and linear MTE assumption may steer toward AEJ Applied/REStat rather than AER/QJE.
